title: The Potter’s Gentle Hands
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who sits still and wonders, and tonight Jeremiah sits in a potter's workshop and watches until he sees the lesson in the clay, just as Wren watches her grandma roll the flopped snowman smooth again.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because quiet truths often hide inside ordinary work, waiting for someone to sit still and watch. In Wren’s world today: Wren’s playdough snowman flopped sideways, and her lip began to wobble. Her grandma only smiled and rolled it back into a smooth round ball. They started again, and it turned out better. Just like the potter who made the clay again, Wren learned that Heavenly Father remakes what bends.
